name: Dark Alley
desc1: This is a filty, dead-end alley, heavily littered with refuse and
desc2: garbage. Rats run away at your approach. It looks as if this is a
desc3: local garbage deposit, and you have to breathe shallowly to stop
desc4: yourself from gagging. You can barely make out a manhole beneath a
desc5: pile of slimy debris, and you can exit the alley to the west.
